001.jpg.story: The lamp here has never been replaced and has never gone out. There is a chair here, and there is no other chair anywhere in the library. Whatever was catalogued here has been recatalogued somewhere further out.

002.jpg.story: The shelves here were counted in a year the librarians no longer acknowledge. The floor slopes very slightly toward the centre of the room. It is said to be the only room where the silence has a direction.

003.jpg.story: The catalogue lists this room twice, under names that disagree about everything but the number. The floor slopes very slightly toward the centre of the room. The last visitor left a note that reads only: not this one either.

004.jpg.story: Someone has been reshelving in the dark, and doing it well. Every volume on the third shelf begins with the same four words. It is said to be the only room where the silence has a direction.

005.jpg.story: The shelves here were counted in a year the librarians no longer acknowledge. The floor slopes very slightly toward the centre of the room. It is filed under a classification that was retired before the shelves were built.

006.jpg.story: A surveyor came here once and left without recording which direction they had entered from. One spine is blank, and the blankness is deliberate. The room is considered complete, and no one will say by whom.
